title: SB1339 (110th General Assembly): As enacted, expands the exception to unlawful carrying or possession of a firearm or firearm ammunition to include carrying or possession in a boat; clarifies that the exception includes a loaded firearm, as well as a firearm or ammunition. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1307.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2017-04-28; crossfiled twin's official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514063646 of https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/110/pub/pc0202.pdf (it names SENATE BILL 1339; own link https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/110/pub/pc0202.pdf not archived))
provenance.note: Chaptered, Public Chapter 202, 2017-04-28, effective July 1, 2017. Printed as House Bill 688 (substituted for SB 1339); this is the twin's copy. The bill replaces all of subsection (e); second quote is part (2)(B). Text has OCR errors in citations.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(e)): (1) lt is an exception to the application of subsection (a) that a person is carrying or possessing a firearm, loaded firearm, or firearm ammunition in a motor vehicle or boat if the person: (A) ls not prohibited from possessing or receiving a firearm by 18 U.S.C $ 922(9) or purchasing a firearm by S 39-17-1316; and (B) ls in lawful possession of the motor vehicle or boat
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(e)): (B) This subsection (e) shall not apply to a motor vehicle or boat that is: (i) Owned or leased by a governmental or private entity that has adopted a written policy prohibiting firearms, loaded firearms, or firearm ammunition not required for employment within the motor vehicle or boat; and (ii) Provided by such entity to an employee for use during the course of employment.
